sections.title: Advanced Concept of Profit and Loss
sections.content: Level 2 includes multiple transactions and combined profit/loss problems. Profit occurs when SP > CP, Loss when SP < CP. Example: An item costing ₹100 is sold first at 10% profit, then at 5% loss.

sections.title: Multi-item Examples in ₹
sections.content: A seller buys and sells multiple items. Example: Item1: CP ₹200, SP ₹240; Item2: CP ₹150, SP ₹135 → Calculate total profit or loss.

sections.title: Successive Profit/Loss Percentage
sections.content: Do not add successive percentages directly. Use formula: Total Profit/Loss % = (Total Profit/Loss ÷ Total CP) × 100. Example: First 10% profit, then 20% profit → approx total 32%.

sections.title: Important Formulas (Hard Level)
sections.content:
1. SP = CP + Profit
2. SP = CP - Loss
3. Profit% = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100
4. Loss% = (Loss ÷ CP) × 100
5. Successive Profit% = [(1 + p1/100)(1 + p2/100) - 1] × 100
6. Successive Loss% = [1 - (1 - l1/100)(1 - l2/100)] × 100

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: Adding successive transactions directly, forgetting total CP/SP calculation, mixing SP and CP in percentage calculation.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Level 2 includes multi-item, successive transactions, combined profit/loss. SP > CP → Profit, SP < CP → Loss. ₹ examples help in faster understanding.

tricks.title: Successive Profit/Loss shortcut
tricks.explanation: Do not add successive % directly. Use formula: (1+p1/100)(1+p2/100)-1.

tricks.title: ₹ based multi-item calculation shortcut
tricks.explanation: Calculate CP and SP of each item separately, then sum them up.
tricks.example: Item1: CP ₹100, SP ₹120; Item2: CP ₹150, SP ₹135 → Net Profit = ₹5

tricks.title: Discount + Profit/Loss quick check
tricks.explanation: SP = Marked Price - Discount, then calculate Profit/Loss %

tricks.title: Profit or Loss ratio trick
tricks.explanation: Profit/Loss ratio = SP : CP, compare mentally.

tricks.title: Multi-step transaction shortcut
tricks.explanation: Calculate CP and SP stepwise, then sum up for net result.
tricks.example: Item1: CP ₹50, SP ₹60; Item2: CP ₹80, SP ₹75 → Net Loss = ₹5

tricks.title: Quick SP vs CP check
tricks.explanation: SP - CP >0 → Profit, SP - CP <0 → Loss
